title: Chart API
description: What the runtime serves the panel's chart (decision 0005 §1.4, 0006 §2.4): GET /api/v1/chart/config, GET /api/v1/chart/symbol/{instrumentId}, GET /api/v1/chart/candles?instrument=&resolution=&from=&to=&countBack=, and the forming bar on the panel socket topic candles/{instrument}/{resolution}. Prices and volumes are decimal strings, times epoch milliseconds. Mirrors src/panel/model/chart/candles.ts.

symbol.description: The instrument id is opaque (a HIP-3 id holds a colon). priceDecimals is 6 − szDecimals on Hyperliquid perps and 8 − szDecimals on spot, from the domain's precision rule; the chart's price scale is 10^priceDecimals.

bar.description: One bar, opened at t. Also the data of a candles/{instrument}/{resolution} message (the forming bar).

candles.description: Oldest first, no duplicate t. noData once the range lies beyond what the venue serves (its most recent 5,000 bars per interval).
